ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation field with non-contiguous, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) scattered across both lobes and dense white clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an approximate 65-degree angle, showing a depth roughly equivalent to 20% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude jagged peaks (15-25 pixel variations) on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve along the trailing edge towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; isolated circular white marks (diameter approx 10-15 pixels) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); prominent vertical streak on the lower-left lobe and several diagonal/horizontal streaks on the mid-to-upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization (white textured clusters) on the distal edges and tips of both lobes; extensive linear rake mark scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible circular ring-shaped scars (possible lamprey or cookiecutter shark marks) on the lower right lobe.
